A '''Triffian''' was among the defenders of the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Deadend]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] stormed the settlement. The Triffian tried to fight off the Jedi with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], but the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] managed to overcome the Triffian and the other defenders. Nevertheless, the Triffian survived the encounter.
